description: This file contains shell script code implementing configuration, setup, and teardown procedures for a direct IP networking protocol using GCOM commands, including functions for initialization, setup, and cleanup of network interfaces.

methods.name: proto_directip_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for the direct IP protocol, defining parameters such as device, apn, pincode, authentication, username, and password.

methods.name: proto_directip_setup
methods.description: Sets up the direct IP interface by verifying device connectivity, configuring PIN if necessary, checking device type, obtaining network interface name, and initiating DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 configurations.

methods.name: proto_directip_teardown
methods.description: Cleans up the direct IP interface, stopping the GCOM connection and updating the network status.
